examples.quote: Fully 87% of their revenues came from advertising in 2008, according to the Organization for Economic Cooperation & Development (OECD).
According to the latest survey, many graduates prefer stable jobs to high-paying ones.
examples.cn: 根据最新调查，许多毕业生更青睐稳定工作而非高薪工作。

confusables.diff: accordingly 是副词，意为“因此；相应地”；according 主要用于 according to 表示“根据”。

cards.question: economic（/ˌiːkəˈnɒmɪk/）
cards.answer: adj.经济的；经济上的；adj.经济学的；adj.有利可图的；有经济效益的
cards.back: adj.经济的；经济上的；adj.经济学的；adj.有利可图的；有经济效益的
answer_points: adj.有利可图的；有经济效益的
cards.analysis: economic：adj.经济的；经济上的；adj.经济学的；adj.有利可图的；有经济效益的。易混 economical，economical 强调“节约的、经济实惠的”，而 economic 强调“经济（体系）的、经济学的”。

meanings.cn: 有利可图的；有经济效益的

examples.quote: A "southern" camp headed by France wants something different: "European economic government" within an inner core of euro-zone members.
The country's economic growth has slowed sharply amid weak global demand.
examples.cn: 在全球需求疲软的背景下，该国经济增长大幅放缓。

confusables.diff: economical 强调“节约的、经济实惠的”，而 economic 强调“经济（体系）的、经济学的”。
financial 侧重“金融的、财务的”，economic 侧重“宏观经济或经济学的”。

cards.question: economy（/ɪˈkɒnəmi/）
cards.answer: n.经济；经济体；n.节约；节省
cards.back: n.经济；经济体；n.节约；节省
cards.analysis: economy：n.经济；经济体；n.节约；节省。易混 economics，economy 指经济体系或节约；economics 指经济学，作学科名时常用单数。

examples.quote: They are energetic participants in a global economy driven by the flow of work, money and ideas.
The digital economy has created new jobs, but it has also widened the skills gap in many industries.
examples.cn: 数字经济创造了新的就业机会，但也扩大了许多行业的技能差距。

confusables.diff: economy 指经济体系或节约；economics 指经济学，作学科名时常用单数。
economy 还可指国家或地区的经济；frugality 更侧重个人消费上的节俭。

cards.question: impact（/ˈɪmpækt/）
cards.answer: n.影响，作用；n.冲击，撞击
cards.back: n.影响，作用；n.冲击，撞击
cards.analysis: impact：n.影响，作用；n.冲击，撞击。易混 effect，effect 侧重结果或效果，impact 侧重作用或冲击。

examples.quote: Mies's signature phrase means that less decoration, properly organized, has more impact than a lot.
The new policy is likely to have a significant impact on small businesses.
examples.cn: 新政策可能会对小企业产生重大影响。

confusables.diff: effect 侧重结果或效果，impact 侧重作用或冲击。
influence 多指潜移默化的影响力，impact 常指显著的冲击或影响。

cards.question: community（/kəˈmjuːnəti/）
cards.answer: n.社区；街区；n.团体，群体；共同体
cards.back: n.社区；街区；n.团体，群体；共同体
cards.analysis: community：n.社区；街区；n.团体，群体；共同体。易混 society，community 强调有共同地域或利益的群体，society 泛指整个社会或社团。

examples.quote: This law abolished special educational requirements for federal jurors and required them to be selected at random from a cross section of the entire community.
The new library has become a meeting place where members of the local community can exchange ideas and learn from one another.
examples.cn: 新图书馆已成为当地社区成员交流思想、相互学习的聚会场所。

confusables.diff: community 强调有共同地域或利益的群体，society 泛指整个社会或社团。
neighborhood 侧重居住区域或邻里，community 还可指有共同利益、身份的群体。

cards.question: privacy（/ˈprɪvəsi/）
cards.answer: n.隐私；私密；n.独处不受打扰的状态；私密空间
cards.back: n.隐私；私密；n.独处不受打扰的状态；私密空间
answer_points: n.独处不受打扰的状态；私密空间
cards.analysis: privacy：n.隐私；私密；n.独处不受打扰的状态；私密空间。易混 secrecy，privacy 强调不受他人窥探或打扰，secrecy 强调有意隐瞒、保密。

meanings.cn: 独处不受打扰的状态；私密空间

examples.quote: The Internet affords anonymity to its users, a blessing to privacy and freedom of speech.
The growing use of smartphones has raised concerns about how companies collect and use personal data, often at the expense of privacy.
examples.cn: 智能手机的日益普及引发了人们对于公司如何收集和使用个人数据的担忧，这往往以牺牲隐私为代价。

confusables.diff: privacy 强调不受他人窥探或打扰，secrecy 强调有意隐瞒、保密。
privacy 侧重个人隐私不受侵犯，confidentiality 侧重信息被保密、不泄露。
privacy 是名词“隐私”，private 是形容词“私人的、私密的”，二者形近。

cards.question: survey（/ˈsɜːveɪ; səˈveɪ/）
cards.answer: n.调查；民意调查；n.测量；勘测；v.调查；审视
cards.back: n.调查；民意调查；n.测量；勘测；v.调查；审视
cards.analysis: survey：n.调查；民意调查；n.测量；勘测；v.调查；审视。易混 poll，poll 多指投票或民意调查，survey 可指更系统的调查或勘测。

examples.quote: A big survey of Indian households in 2004 found that nearly 40% of emigrants had more than a high-school education, compared with around 3.3% of all Indians over the age 25.
A recent survey found that most graduates value practical skills more than academic qualifications.
examples.cn: 最近一项调查发现，大多数毕业生更看重实践技能而非学历。

confusables.diff: poll 多指投票或民意调查，survey 可指更系统的调查或勘测。

cards.question: tech（/tek/）
cards.answer: n.技术；科技（technology 的非正式缩略，常作定语）
cards.back: n.技术；科技（technology 的非正式缩略，常作定语）
answer_points: n.技术；科技（technology 的非正式缩略，常作定语）
cards.analysis: tech：n.技术；科技（technology 的非正式缩略，常作定语）。易混 technology，technology 是完整名词，泛指技术、工艺；tech 是其非正式缩略，更常用于行业、公司等语境。

meanings.cn: 技术；科技（technology 的非正式缩略，常作定语）

examples.quote: However, Google and other big tech providers monitor their efficiency closely and make improvements.
The rapid rise of tech has changed how people work, learn and communicate.
examples.cn: 科技的迅速崛起改变了人们工作、学习和交流的方式。

confusables.diff: technology 是完整名词，泛指技术、工艺；tech 是其非正式缩略，更常用于行业、公司等语境。
technique 指具体的技巧、方法；tech 不表示技巧，而表示技术或科技。

cards.question: manufacturing（/ˌmænjuˈfæktʃərɪŋ/）
cards.answer: n.制造业；n.制造；生产
cards.back: n.制造业；n.制造；生产
cards.analysis: manufacturing：n.制造业；n.制造；生产。易混 manufacture，manufacture 可作动词或名词，指制造行为或产品；manufacturing 多作名词，强调制造业或制造过程。

examples.quote: The decline in American manufacturing is a common refrain, particularly from Donald Trump.
The shift from manufacturing to services has reshaped employment patterns in many advanced economies.
examples.cn: 从制造业向服务业的转变重塑了许多发达经济体的就业格局。

confusables.diff: manufacture 可作动词或名词，指制造行为或产品；manufacturing 多作名词，强调制造业或制造过程。
production 泛指生产活动与产量，manufacturing 更特指工业加工制造。

cards.question: negative（/ˈneɡətɪv/）
cards.answer: adj.消极的；负面的；否定的；n.负面因素；否定回答
cards.back: adj.消极的；负面的；否定的；n.负面因素；否定回答
cards.analysis: negative：adj.消极的；负面的；否定的；n.负面因素；否定回答。易混 pessimistic，pessimistic 强调对未来悲观，negative 泛指负面、消极或否定。

examples.quote: We become defensive when criticised, and apply negative stereotypes to others to boost our own esteem.
A negative attitude can undermine even the most carefully designed study plan.
examples.cn: 消极态度甚至会削弱最精心设计的学习计划。

confusables.diff: pessimistic 强调对未来悲观，negative 泛指负面、消极或否定。

cards.question: guilt（/ɡɪlt/）
cards.answer: n.内疚，愧疚；n.有罪，罪责
cards.back: n.内疚，愧疚；n.有罪，罪责
cards.analysis: guilt：n.内疚，愧疚；n.有罪，罪责。易混 shame，guilt 多指因做错事而产生的内疚或有罪，shame 侧重羞耻感或丢脸。

examples.quote: You may feel guilt over your past, but you are poisoning the present with the things and circumstances you cannot change.
He was consumed by guilt after realizing that his silence had allowed the mistake to go uncorrected.
examples.cn: 意识到自己的沉默使这个错误未能得到纠正后，他深感内疚。

confusables.diff: guilt 多指因做错事而产生的内疚或有罪，shame 侧重羞耻感或丢脸。
gilt 意为“镀金材料、金边证券”，与 guilt 拼写相近但意义无关。

phrases.cn: （非正式）让人感到内疚；内疚攻势

cards.question: participants（/pɑːrˈtɪsəpənts/）
cards.answer: n.参与者；参加者；n.参与方
cards.back: n.参与者；参加者；n.参与方
cards.analysis: participants：n.参与者；参加者；n.参与方。易混 contestants，contestants 通常指比赛的参赛者或竞争者，participants 更泛指参与某项活动、研究或项目的人。

examples.quote: They are energetic participants in a global economy driven by the flow of work, money and ideas.
The researchers assured participants that their responses would remain confidential and be used only for academic purposes.
examples.cn: 研究人员向参与者保证，他们的回答将保密并仅用于学术目的。

confusables.diff: contestants 通常指比赛的参赛者或竞争者，participants 更泛指参与某项活动、研究或项目的人。
attendees 强调到场出席的人，participants 强调实际参与活动或研究的人。
subjects 在研究中指受试者，语气偏客观；participants 更强调参与者的主体身份。

cards.question: significant（/sɪɡˈnɪfɪkənt/）
cards.answer: adj.重要的；重大的；adj.有意义的；意味深长的；adj.显著的；明显的
cards.back: adj.重要的；重大的；adj.有意义的；意味深长的；adj.显著的；明显的
cards.analysis: significant：adj.重要的；重大的；adj.有意义的；意味深长的；adj.显著的；明显的。易混 substantial，substantial 侧重数量大或实质性的，而 significant 更强调重要、有意义或统计显著。

examples.quote: Conversely, if homework matters, it should account for a significant portion of the grade.
The study found a significant difference between the two groups, which may influence future treatment.
examples.cn: 研究发现两组之间存在显著差异，这可能影响未来的治疗方案。

confusables.diff: substantial 侧重数量大或实质性的，而 significant 更强调重要、有意义或统计显著。
considerable 侧重数量或程度大，而 significant 更强调重要性、意义或统计显著性。
important 是普通“重要”，而 significant 常暗含影响深远或具有意义。

cards.question: corporate（/ˈkɔːpərət/）
cards.answer: adj.公司的；企业的；adj.法人的；社团的；adj.共同的；全体的
cards.back: adj.公司的；企业的；adj.法人的；社团的；adj.共同的；全体的
cards.analysis: corporate：adj.公司的；企业的；adj.法人的；社团的；adj.共同的；全体的。易混 corporation，corporation 是名词，指公司或法人；corporate 是形容词，指公司的或法人的。

examples.quote: In particular, the corporate workplace will never be completely family-friendly until women are part of senior management decisions, and Europe's top corporate-governance positions remain overwhelmingly male.
The scandal damaged the company's corporate image and prompted calls for stricter governance.
examples.cn: 这起丑闻损害了公司的企业形象，并引发了加强治理的呼声。

confusables.diff: corporation 是名词，指公司或法人；corporate 是形容词，指公司的或法人的。
cooperate 是动词，意为合作；corporate 是形容词，意为公司的。

cards.question: financial（/faɪˈnænʃl/）
cards.answer: adj.财政的；金融的；adj.财务的
cards.back: adj.财政的；金融的；adj.财务的
cards.analysis: financial：adj.财政的；金融的；adj.财务的。易混 fiscal，fiscal 多指政府财政和税收，financial 泛指金融、财务和资金。

examples.quote: If you're not convinced of the inherent value in taking a year off to explore interests, then consider its financial impact on future academic choices.
Many students rely on financial aid to cover tuition and living expenses during graduate study.
examples.cn: 许多学生在研究生学习期间依靠经济援助支付学费和生活费。

confusables.diff: fiscal 多指政府财政和税收，financial 泛指金融、财务和资金。
monetary 侧重货币供应与政策，financial 侧重资金、金融和财务活动。
economic 指经济体系或经济状况，financial 指与资金、金融相关的。

cards.question: jury（/ˈdʒʊəri/）
cards.answer: n.陪审团；n.（竞赛的）评审团，裁判团
cards.back: n.陪审团；n.（竞赛的）评审团，裁判团
cards.analysis: jury：n.陪审团；n.（竞赛的）评审团，裁判团。易混 juror，juror 指陪审团中的一名成员，jury 指整个陪审团。

examples.quote: The jury is also said to be the best surviving example of direct rather than representative democracy.
The jury acquitted the defendant after deliberating for less than two hours.
examples.cn: 陪审团审议不到两小时便裁定被告无罪。

confusables.diff: juror 指陪审团中的一名成员，jury 指整个陪审团。
panel 常指专家小组或评审小组，jury 更常指法律上的陪审团。

cards.question: current（/ˈkʌrənt/）
cards.answer: adj.当前的；现行的；n.水流；气流；电流；n.潮流；趋势
cards.back: adj.当前的；现行的；n.水流；气流；电流；n.潮流；趋势
cards.analysis: current：adj.当前的；现行的；n.水流；气流；电流；n.潮流；趋势。易混 currant，currant 指葡萄干或醋栗，current 指水流、电流或当前的；二者同音但拼写和词义不同。

examples.quote: The current downturn in the art market is the worst since the Japanese stopped buying Impressionists at the end of 1989.
The survey reveals that current policies fail to address the needs of younger workers.
examples.cn: 调查显示，现行政策未能满足年轻劳动者的需求。

confusables.diff: currant 指葡萄干或醋栗，current 指水流、电流或当前的；二者同音但拼写和词义不同。
present 多指此刻存在的或出席的；current 强调当前有效或正在进行的。

cards.question: landscape（/ˈlændskeɪp/）
cards.answer: n.风景，景色；地貌景观；n.（某一领域的）形势，格局；v.对（土地）进行景观美化
cards.back: n.风景，景色；地貌景观；n.（某一领域的）形势，格局；v.对（土地）进行景观美化
cards.analysis: landscape：n.风景，景色；地貌景观；n.（某一领域的）形势，格局；v.对（土地）进行景观美化。易混 scenery，scenery 常作不可数名词，泛指自然风景或舞台布景；landscape 可数，常指陆上景观或某一领域的格局。

examples.quote: Aesthetic effect came from the landscape, new materials and forthright detailing.
Digital technology has reshaped the media landscape, forcing traditional publishers to rethink their business models.
examples.cn: 数字技术重塑了媒体格局，迫使传统出版商重新思考其商业模式。

confusables.diff: scenery 常作不可数名词，泛指自然风景或舞台布景；landscape 可数，常指陆上景观或某一领域的格局。
view 强调从某处看到的景色，也可指观点；landscape 强调整片地貌景观或总体局势。

cards.question: obesity（/əʊˈbiːsəti/）
cards.answer: n.肥胖；肥胖症
cards.back: n.肥胖；肥胖症
cards.analysis: obesity：n.肥胖；肥胖症。易混 adiposity，adiposity 更偏学术，强调脂肪组织过多；obesity 更常用，指体重超标或肥胖症。

examples.quote: They argue that government action is necessary to curb Britain's addiction to unhealthy food and help halt spiraling rates of obesity, diabetes and heart disease.
The rising rate of obesity has prompted governments to consider taxes on sugary drinks.
examples.cn: 肥胖率上升促使各国政府考虑对含糖饮料征税。

confusables.diff: adiposity 更偏学术，强调脂肪组织过多；obesity 更常用，指体重超标或肥胖症。

cards.question: recession（/rɪˈseʃn/）
cards.answer: n.经济衰退；不景气；n.后退；撤回
cards.back: n.经济衰退；不景气；n.后退；撤回
cards.analysis: recession：n.经济衰退；不景气；n.后退；撤回。易混 depression，depression 指更严重、持续时间更长的经济萧条，而 recession 通常指较短暂的经济衰退。

examples.quote: The recession threatened to remove the advertising and readers that had not already fled to the internet.
The country has slipped into its first recession in a decade as consumer spending falls.
examples.cn: 随着消费者支出下降，该国已陷入十年来的首次经济衰退。

confusables.diff: depression 指更严重、持续时间更长的经济萧条，而 recession 通常指较短暂的经济衰退。
downturn 泛指经济或活动的下降趋势，recession 则更正式地指经济连续萎缩的衰退期。

cards.question: became（/bɪˈkeɪm/）
cards.answer: v.成为；变成（become 的过去式）；v.变得（后接形容词）
cards.back: v.成为；变成（become 的过去式）；v.变得（后接形容词）
answer_points: v.成为；变成（become 的过去式）
cards.analysis: became：v.成为；变成（become 的过去式）；v.变得（后接形容词）。易混 become，become 是原形/现在式，became 是其过去式。

meanings.cn: 成为；变成（become 的过去式）

examples.quote: In the weeks and months that followed Mr. Hirst's sale, spending of any sort became deeply unfashionable.
As online education expanded, it became clear that traditional assessment methods were no longer sufficient.
examples.cn: 随着在线教育扩展，人们逐渐认识到传统评估方法已不再足够。

confusables.diff: become 是原形/现在式，became 是其过去式。

cards.question: boost（/buːst/）
cards.answer: v.促进，推动；使增长，提高；v.增强（信心、士气等）；使振奋；n.增长，提高；推动，激励
cards.back: v.促进，推动；使增长，提高；v.增强（信心、士气等）；使振奋；n.增长，提高；推动，激励
answer_points: v.增强（信心、士气等）；使振奋
cards.analysis: boost：v.促进，推动；使增长，提高；v.增强（信心、士气等）；使振奋；n.增长，提高；推动，激励。易混 boast，boast 意为吹嘘、自夸；boost 意为促进、提高。

meanings.cn: 增强（信心、士气等）；使振奋

examples.quote: He said that manufacturers of crisps and candies could play a central role in the Change4Life campaign, the centrepiece of government efforts to boost healthy eating and fitness.
The new tax incentives are intended to boost consumer spending and revive the sluggish economy.

cards.question: emotional（/ɪˈməʊʃənl/）

cards.analysis: emotional：adj.情感的；情绪的；adj.易动感情的；情绪激动的；adj.令人动情的；引起情感共鸣的。易混 emotive，emotive 多指话题或词语能激起情感，emotional 更常指人的情绪状态或情感性质。

examples.quote: It is deeply uncomfortable – it's the emotional equivalent of wearing a jacket weighted with stones.

cards.question: global（/ˈɡloʊbl/）

cards.analysis: global：adj.全球的；全世界的；adj.全面的；整体的。易混 worldwide，global 强调全球范围或整体性，worldwide 强调遍及全世界，也可作副词。

examples.quote: The outbreak of swine flu that was first detected in Mexico was declared a global epidemic on June 11, 2009.

examples.cn: 气候变化是一项全球性挑战，需要国际合作和长期解决方案。

confusables.diff: global 强调全球范围或整体性，worldwide 强调遍及全世界，也可作副词。
global 侧重全球或整体范围，general 侧重普遍、一般而非具体。

Policies should be designed to protect individual rights while serving the public good.

examples.quote: Instead of saying: "If we set an end-of-quarter deadline, we will never make it," say, "This is just my opinion, but I don't see how we will make that deadline." Having asserted your opinion (as a position, not as a fact), demonstrate equal curiosity about other views.

examples.quote: Powerful memory doesn't make my emotions any more acute or vivid.
People who can identify and manage their emotions tend to handle stress more effectively.
examples.cn: 能够识别和管理自己情绪的人往往更能有效应对压力。

confusables.diff: emotion 指某种情绪，emotions 指多种情绪或整体情绪状态。

examples.quote: But a new study published in Cognition found that, in at least one real-world situation, a single ethics lesson may have had lasting effects.

confusables.diff: gasp 意为“喘气”，与 gaps（缺口/差距）拼写相近但词义不同。

Pollution and land development are destroying the natural habitat of many endangered species.
examples.cn: 污染和土地开发正在破坏许多濒危物种的自然栖息地。

confusables.diff: habit 意为“习惯”；habitat 指动植物的自然栖息地。

cards.question: infrastructure（/ˈɪnfrəstrʌktʃə(r)/）

cards.back: n.基础设施；基础建设；n.基础结构；基础体系
cards.analysis: infrastructure：n.基础设施；基础建设；n.基础结构；基础体系。易混 facility，facility 常指具体设施或设备，infrastructure 指支撑社会运转的基础设施系统。

examples.quote: When the government talks about infrastructure contributing to the economy the focus is usually on roads, railways, broadband and energy.

examples.cn: 没有充足的基础设施，偏远地区不太可能吸引到持续发展所需的投资。

confusables.diff: facility 常指具体设施或设备，infrastructure 指支撑社会运转的基础设施系统。

cards.question: instance（/ˈɪnstəns/）
